subject.title: [Bug]: Default sandbox image openclaw-sandbox:bookworm-slim lacked python3, breaking edit/write

question: Should OpenClaw treat Python-less custom Docker sandbox images as a core-supported write/edit path, or close the linked fork PR as superseded/out of scope now that the default image is fixed?
rationale: The original default-image bug is fixed and shipped, but the remaining discussion asks whether custom slim images should get more diagnostics or a Python-optional mutation path; that boundary affects sandbox support policy and the open closing PR.

options.title: Close linked PR as superseded
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as covered by the shipped default-image fix, document custom images as needing python3 or python, and then close this issue.

options.title: Sponsor custom-image diagnostics
options.body: Ask the linked PR or a replacement to narrow itself to custom-image missing-Python diagnostics with focused tests and no default-image churn.

options.title: Support Python-optional mutations
options.body: Treat Python-less custom images as in scope and request a design for a maintained non-Python mutation implementation before code lands.

recommendation.title: Close linked PR as superseded
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as covered by the shipped default-image fix, document custom images as needing python3 or python, and then close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the default-image fallback fix and are the clearest current owner for deciding whether the remaining custom-image behavior is in scope.
